decision.rewritten_request: Compare the departments with total worked hours exceeding 10 (from 2026-08-03 to 2026-09-06) with last month's data.

employee_resolution.updated_request:
Request:
Compare that with last month.

reference_trace.sql_planner_1:
SELECT
    a.department,
    SUM(a.total_worked_hrs) AS total_hours,
    (SELECT SUM(total_worked_hrs) FROM attendance_records a2 WHERE a2.department = a.department AND a2.attendance_date >= '2026-08-03'::date AND a2.attendance_date < '2026-09-07'::date) AS last_month_hours
FROM attendance_records a
WHERE a.attendance_date >= '2026-08-03'::date AND a.attendance_date < '2026-09-07'::date
GROUP BY a.department
HAVING total_hours > 10
ORDER BY total_hours DESC;
reference_trace.sql_planner_2:
SELECT
    a.department,
    SUM(a.total_worked_hrs) AS current_month_hours,
    (SELECT SUM(total_worked_hrs) FROM attendance_records a2 WHERE a2.department = a.department AND a2.attendance_date >= '2026-08-03'::date AND a2.attendance_date < '2026-09-07'::date) AS last_month_hours
FROM attendance_records a
WHERE a.attendance_date >= '2026-08-03'::date AND a.attendance_date < '2026-09-07'::date
GROUP BY a.department
HAVING current_month_hours > 10
ORDER BY current_month_hours DESC;
